Sonic Airdrop Burn and Final Claim Deadline
Sonic Team
Apr 2, 2026
2 min
Important Dates for Season 1 and Season 2 Claimants
Approximately
32,690,000 S
remains unclaimed across Season 1 and Season 2 airdrop allocations and will be burned on
October 15, 2026
if not claimed before the deadline.
The remaining locked balances are approximately:
In total, approximately
32.69M S
remains locked in the contract and is still claimable by eligible fNFT holders before the final cutoff.
What fNFT Holders Need to Know
Eligible holders can still unlock and claim the remaining S tied to their airdrop position.
For both seasons, claims made before full unlock may still incur a penalty (make sure to check the applicable penalty for your position via airdrop claim dashboards).
After each season reaches full unlock, the remaining allocation can be claimed in full with no penalty. Once the final deadline passes, any amount still left locked will be permanently burned.
Claim Timeline
Season 1
Now until April 18, 2026:
claims remain available and subject to penalty
April 18, 2026 to October 15, 2026:
claims can be made with
no penalty
After October 15, 2026:
any unclaimed locked amount becomes eligible to be burned
Season 2
Now until May 24, 2026:
claims remain available and subject to penalty
May 24, 2026 to October 15, 2026:
claims can be made with
no penalty
After October 15, 2026:
any unclaimed locked amount becomes eligible to be burned
For live data on remaining allocated tokens, visit the Sonic burn dashboard:
https://burn.soniclabs.com/
Claim portal:
https://my.soniclabs.com/airdrop
PaintSwap fNFT orderbook:
https://airdrop.paintswap.io/
The Airdrop’s Final Stage
The upcoming burn marks the
final stage
of the Season 1 and Season 2 airdrop claim process.
It sets a clear deadline for remaining claims and ensures that unclaimed locked allocations do not remain in the contract indefinitely.
Any S that remains unclaimed after the cutoff may be permanently removed from supply, as the contract allows anyone to trigger the burn of the remaining locked balance once the burn date is reached.
For eligible holders, the message is straightforward:
claim before October 15, 2026 to avoid losing any remaining allocation.
Claim portal:
https://my.soniclabs.com/airdrop
PaintSwap fNFT orderbook:
https://airdrop.paintswap.io/
Future Token Allocation
As outlined in
Sonic’s Airdrop Economics Update
, Sonic is moving away from a one-size-fits-all airdrop model and toward a more targeted approach to growth. The remaining incentive allocation continues to be reserved for future airdrops, incentives, or burn, with no additional airdrop minting planned.
